assumptions.text: Lessons L1 and L8 are marked learned. Their checks are the existing tests test_e11_harness_has_no_stale_name and test_e6_workflow_prose_has_no_long_sentence. I did not run lessons.py check, because that script does not exist yet.
The lesson set is 8 rows distilled from the memory snapshot. I left out the project-history notes (features, ADRs) and kept only rules. Helpful and harmful counters start at 0.

The CLAUDE.md content is folded into AGENTS.md as a '## Harness' section plus a '## Memory' section. AGENTS.md is vendored into adopters, so they will also receive the harness-specific rules. Vendoring and the E4 seeding belong to a later task.
A check of the form `path::name` exists when the file exists and contains `def name(`. A `none: ...` check needs helpful >= 1 to count as evidence.
Only rows with status `learned` are checked. Other statuses are ignored.
The suite failure 'CLAUDE.md missing //stack/' is not caused by this task. It comes from CLAUDE.md now being only `@AGENTS.md`.
Only reviewer rejections in run_task are recorded; T0 (contract) rejections are not, since R1 and E8 concern task attempts. Failed checks and reviewer call errors are not findings.
Reflection is skipped when memory/lessons.md or the reflector role is missing, so older adopter configs keep working.
A helpful delta promotes a lesson to learned only when its status is captured.
A pipe character in lesson text is replaced with / to keep the markdown table valid.
A delta naming an unknown lesson id is ignored silently.
I edited tests/conftest.py so the slice_repo fixture maps the reflector to the fake CLI; otherwise existing accept tests would call the real claude CLI.
The lesson count is a paragraph under the result table, not a table row, so the text 'Lessons 4 learned / 6' is contiguous as E14 requires.
The Lessons prompt section lists `id: lesson` per row, and is empty (omitted) when no lesson qualifies.
spec.py now imports scripts/lessons.py, which uses only the standard library.
prose.py imports spec.prose and reuses MAX_WORDS=25, so the limit lives in one place; the inline dependency on markdown is declared because spec.py imports it.
Charter and constitution needed no rewrite because the existing prose() splits per physical line and they already pass. I did not change how it splits.
tests/test_repo_memory.py::test_e4_vendor_seeds_memory fails after my change. It concerns vendor.sh seeding memory/lessons, outside T6 scope, and I did not touch vendor.sh.

The old CLAUDE.md stub (stack, workflow and hard-rules prose) is replaced by `@AGENTS.md`, because E4 requires CLAUDE.md to equal the import. Adopters lose that prose; AGENTS.md is the copied-verbatim harness file and carries the workflow and hard rules.
The lessons header is read from the source repo's memory/lessons.md (head -5) rather than duplicated in vendor.sh, so the two cannot drift.
The new files are SEED, not KEEP: they are written if absent and never clobbered, so an existing target file gets a .harness-new copy.
docs/vendoring.md mirrors the KEEP/SEED classification and was not updated. It is outside this task, and the first bash attempt to edit it was not needed.
